Ava / team —

I reviewed the MAP and added a dedicated "Canary runbook" sheet in the attached XLSX (column added: rollback_steps, smoke_checks, metric_thresholds). Summary of changes / clarifications:

- Canary scope: Clinic A only, up to 250 daily sessions. We will enable prefix/KV caching to match peak patterns and limit request fanout.
- Monitoring windows: we will evaluate 72 hours of continuous telemetry (latency p50/p95, error rate, token cost) and hold on additional migrations until thresholds are met.
- Rollback plan: automated traffic switch to previous model variant + manual DB disconnect step (step 4 in runbook) — should be doable in under 30 mins if pre-approved.
- Network checklist: ensure VPN endpoint to our VPC is tested; per-network doc, MTU and routing entries must be set by 2026-06-18 to meet provisioning window.

I'm attaching a lightweight smoke test script and a short list of telemetry dashboards we'll use. Rafael, I flagged two migration staffers (Miguel and Priya) to be on-call the first weekend.

Neha

John / team —

I'll take the training plan. Proposed approach:

1) Train-the-trainer session (90 minutes, remote): 2026-07-01 13:00 ET with up to 8 clinic super-users.
2) Two end-user webinars (45 minutes each) per clinic the week after the canary (2026-07-13 and 2026-07-14). Recordings and quick-reference guides will be posted to the shared Drive.
3) Post-go-live office hours (twice weekly for 2 weeks) for rapid triage.

Success criteria for the canary (to be included in MAP):
- Avg response latency p95 < 800 ms under measured load.
- Error rate < 0.5% sustained during monitoring window.
- No >1 major incident requiring rollback.
- At least 80% of trained super-users complete the short knowledge check within 3 days.

I'll add the training schedule CSV to the MAP and upload links. Rafael: let me know if you want a joint run-through prior to the canary.
